reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 describes a non-uniform, mixed Mn-Cr-Fe oxide on a different alloy, with no Cu-rich outer layer or Cr-rich spinel sublayer. E2 mentions a Cr-oxide and a (Fe,Co,Ni,Mn,Cu)3O4 spinel on an equiatomic FeCoNiMnCu coating, but no Cu-rich outer layer or dual-layer structure. E3 concerns a W-doped FeCoCrNiAl alloy, irrelevant to Cu-Cr oxidation. None of the evidence supports the specific dual-layer oxide structure, its formation mechanism, or its role in wear resistance for FeNiCrCoCu.
